accessibility: Native labeled selects/buttons, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion and320px reflow. Read priors, token/density/log contributions, normalizer, posterior, predicted class or tagged rejection/undefined reason in a numerical table plus explanation. Curves/bars are redundant; no hover/color/spatial-only meaning. Extreme float underflow is explicitly distinguished from mathematical zero.
comparison: NB combines assumed class-conditional likelihoods; existing Logistic models a linear logit. Compare on identical unseen rows and costs, not unrelated accuracy figures. No new Logistic fitting or calibration algorithm is introduced by this manifest.

configurations.counterexample: The same document count prior can coexist with different token totals. Never substitute number of documents for a token denominator or fit vocabulary on held-out text.
configurations.explanation: Multiply token likelihoods once per occurrence (or add their logs) with class priors, then normalize. Alpha smooths class-token counts, not document counts. Empty known evidence leaves the prior; ignoring an unknown token does not prove it uninformative in reality.

controls: Only complete listed configuration tuples; no unrestricted text, counts, queries, priors, alpha, variances or Cartesian expansion.

fixtures.feature_semantics: Token occurrences, not document frequencies; vocabulary sorted from training tokens only.
fixtures.unknown_policy: Ignore tokens absent from frozen training vocabulary; report unknown count. Unknown-only query is empty evidence, not impossible evidence.

interaction: Record prediction and bounded reason before reveal; show fixture inputs first, then numerical/text evidence. Change one listed configuration and explain a changed transfer case. Wrong initial predictions can recover. No experiment credit awards mastery.
learning_goals: Distinguish prior, likelihood and posterior; normalize class-conditional evidence
Explain conditional independence as an assumption, not causality
Distinguish token smoothing from document-count priors
learning_question: How do priors, word evidence and additive smoothing change a documentation class posterior?
provenance: Wholly fictional human-label placeholders for teaching, not production labels or LLM ground truth. No data collection.

reason_options.label: Normalize class-conditional evidence with the declared prior and representation
Invalid representation/variance/provenance or zero evidence prevents a defined prediction
Accuracy proves causal effects and calibrated confidence
